configuration.databaseConnections: Separate pooled Neon URLs for production and preview; use the returned URI unchanged
configuration.secrets: Server-only Vercel environment values; independent cron and abuse secrets per environment
configuration.email: Existing Resend key and sender preserved; explicitly authorized for protected preview
configuration.previewDefault: Demo acceptance; real email test used a deployment-specific override

verification.preview: Nine-step browser inquiry accepted, one database record and two queue jobs sent on first attempt; owner confirmed both messages
verification.production: HTTP 202 accepted, one database record and two queue jobs sent on first attempt; owner confirmed both messages
verification.idempotency: Preview replay returned HTTP 200 and the original request ID; one inquiry and two jobs, each still at one attempt

releaseRequirements: All required CI checks passing on release commit
Promote the verified staged production build only after launch requirements are resolved
hostingDecision: Owner explicitly requested proceeding on current free plans after being informed that Vercel Hobby restricts commercial use. No billing changes or paid upgrades authorized or made; this does not establish commercial-use eligibility.
recovery: Database outbox keeps pending jobs if queue publication fails. Authenticated /api/maintenance retries due jobs and applies 90-day app-data retention. Inspect failed/ambiguous delivery jobs and provider evidence before resending. Alerts go to the configured owner inbox.
